name: Object Details
query:
SELECT 
    REPLACE(project.project_name, '_', ' ') AS `Project Name`,
    REPLACE(project.object_title, '_', ' ') AS `Object Title`,
    project.status AS `Status`,
    project.project__object_size_in_hecter AS `Object Size (Hecter)`,
    project.project__object_price_per_hecter AS `Price Per Hecter`,
    REPLACE(project.task, '_', ' ') AS `Task`,
    REPLACE(project.sla_class, '_', ' ') AS `SLA Class`,
    REPLACE(project.work_team, '_', ' ') AS `Work Team`,
    project.team_leader AS `Team Leader`,
    user.full_name AS `Team Leader Name`
FROM 
    `tabProject Setup` project
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabUser` user ON project.team_leader = user.name
GROUP BY 
    project.project_name, project.object_title, project.status,
    project.project__object_size_in_hecter, project.project__object_price_per_hecter,
    project.task, project.sla_class, project.work_team,
    project.team_leader, user.full_name
ORDER BY 
    project.project_name;
